beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Milan joins inherited house authority to contemporary systems of staging, craft, platform distribution, wholesale and traceability. This chapter follows staging: Atmosphere is engineered through temporary architecture, power, light, sound, seating, cueing, safety and teardown—then edited out of the effortless final image.
beats.onScreen: Then: CNMI’s Fashion Hub uses Palazzo Giureconsulti as a meeting and presentation site for selected emerging designers.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CNMI’s Fashion Hub uses Palazzo Giureconsulti as a meeting and presentation site for selected emerging designers. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The official calendar coordinates shows, presentations and digital events across Milan rather than specifying one permanent runway venue.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Room-level lighting, sound, power, accessibility and supplier specifications remain event-by-event reporting assignments.
